Companion Animal Travel Desk Policy for Animal Transit Support

This section sets the standard for calm, safe, and clear service when handling companion animals at Aurelia Skyways. Staff must protect animal welfare first, give passengers direct guidance, and keep each transfer orderly.

Treat every animal with a calm approach and use humane handling at all times. Speak in plain words, confirm crate readiness, and check that food, water, bedding, and documents are in place before acceptance. If a passenger needs help, provide brief instructions and avoid rushed language. Use the pet lounge only as approved, and keep the area clean, quiet, and monitored. <<FACT F001>> Do not promise space, release, or onward movement until the required check is complete. When any concern appears, pause the handoff and report it through the normal desk channel.

Passengers should receive clear direction before departure so they know where to go, what to present, and how their animal will be moved. <<FACT F019>> If a traveler arrives with Buddy or another pet that seems unsettled, slow the process, reduce noise, and ask the senior coordinator to review the case. Never separate a passenger from an animal without a service reason, and never use force unless there is an immediate safety need.

Record each case with accurate notes, including acceptance issues, comfort needs, and any special instructions passed to the next team. Keep communication consistent so the traveler sees steady service from first contact to release.

For questions or escalation, contact the senior coordinator at the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
